stem:
The diagram shows Kabir's choices for heating dal: an iron pan, a wooden handle, and a shiny plastic pan. He must pick a pan to heat the dal and a handle for a hot iron pan.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: An iron pan is suitable for heating dal because iron conducts heat well.
An iron handle is safer than a wooden handle on the hot iron pan.
A wooden handle becomes a good heat conductor when fixed to the iron pan.
Shiny plastic is suitable for a heating pan because it conducts heat well.

teacher.key_rationale: Iron conducts heat well, so it suits a heating pan. A metal handle is less safe than wood; wood stays a poor conductor; shiny plastic does not conduct heat well for a cooking vessel.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote force block into iron pan, wooden handle, and shiny plastic pan.
